records.safety_message: Do not attempt removal. Observe only and consult local land managers if you have concerns.

records.general_information: Bidens pilosa is listed as invasive in Malaysia by GRIIS Malaysia v1.3. Erect annual herb with black barbed seeds that stick to clothing and animals.
records.safety_message: Follow reviewed guidance before any action. Observation and reporting are always safe.

records.general_information: Chromolaena odorata is listed as invasive in Malaysia by GRIIS Malaysia v1.3. Woody shrub or scrambler that spreads by wind-borne seeds.
records.safety_message: Do not disturb flowering or seed-bearing plants. Follow reviewed guidance before any action.

records.general_information: Eichhornia crassipes is listed as invasive in Malaysia by GRIIS Malaysia v1.3. Free-floating aquatic plant that forms dense mats.
records.safety_message: Do not enter water to remove. Report the sighting; removal requires trained crews.

records.general_information: Mikania micrantha is listed as invasive in Malaysia by MyIAS 2025 and GRIIS Malaysia v1.3. Fast-growing climbing vine that smothers native vegetation.
records.safety_message: Follow reviewed guidance before any action. Bag every fragment.

records.general_information: Oxalis corniculata is listed as invasive in Malaysia by GRIIS Malaysia v1.3. Low creeping herb with three heart-shaped leaflets and yellow flowers.
records.safety_message: Follow reviewed guidance before any action.

records.general_information: Psidium guajava is listed as invasive in Malaysia by GRIIS Malaysia v1.3. Small tree with fragrant fruit; naturalises rapidly in disturbed sites.
records.safety_message: Do not attempt removal on private, protected or unfamiliar land. Follow reviewed guidance.

records.general_information: Asclepias curassavica is listed as invasive in Malaysia by GRIIS Malaysia v1.3. Erect herb with orange-red flowers and milky sap.
records.safety_message: Sap is toxic. Wear gloves. Follow reviewed guidance before any action.

records.general_information: Megathyrsus maximus is listed as invasive in Malaysia by GRIIS Malaysia v1.3. Tall clumping grass that forms dense stands and fuels fire.
records.safety_message: Follow reviewed guidance before any action.

records.general_information: Mimosa diplotricha is listed as invasive in Malaysia by GRIIS Malaysia v1.3. Thorny scrambling shrub that forms impenetrable thickets.
records.safety_message: Sharp recurved thorns. Do not attempt beginner removal. Report the sighting.

records.general_information: Mimosa pigra is listed as invasive in Malaysia by MyIAS 2025 and GRIIS Malaysia v1.3. Prickly shrub that invades wetlands.
records.safety_message: Sharp prickles. Do not attempt beginner removal. Report the sighting.

records.general_information: Alternanthera philoxeroides is listed as invasive in Malaysia by MyIAS 2025. Aquatic and semi-aquatic herb that regrows from fragments.
records.safety_message: Never disturb mechanically - fragments re-establish rapidly. Report only.

records.general_information: Parthenium hysterophorus is listed as invasive in Malaysia by MyIAS 2025. Erect annual herb causing serious human respiratory and skin harm.
records.safety_message: Do not handle. Highly toxic to humans and livestock. Report only.

records.general_information: Ageratina adenophora is on the Malaysian watchlist (MyIAS 2025) but not currently recorded in Malaysia.
records.safety_message: Do not act on this plant. Observation and reporting only if positively identified.

records.general_information: Sida acuta is listed as invasive in Malaysia by GRIIS Malaysia v1.3. Woody-based herb with tough fibrous stems.
records.safety_message: Follow reviewed guidance before any action.

records.general_information: Miconia crenata is a recognised member of the PULIH v4 model's invasive category, but a reviewed Malaysian status source is not yet attached to this species in the catalogue.
records.safety_message: Do not act on this plant. Observation only until expert review completes.
